sources.title: Retrieval Metrics: Recall@K, MRR and nDCG | AI Understanding
sources.snippet: What is Retrieval Metrics: Recall@K, MRR and nDCG? Recall@K measures how many known relevant items appear in the top K results, MRR emphasizes the rank of the first relevant item, and nDCG evaluates ranking quality using graded relevance with position discounts.
